fields.label: New Schools
fields.description: Defaults for Onboard a School: one form that registers a school, starts its trial or records its first payment, claims its address and builds its site.

fields.label: Approve and build the site straight away
fields.description: Off: new schools wait in Pending Approval for another platform admin.

fields.label: Automation
fields.description: What the Control Center does by itself, so nobody has to remember.

fields.label: Issue the licence key when a site is ready
fields.description: Signs and emails the key from the school's plan as soon as its site is built (needs the signing key).

fields.label: Issue a new key after each renewal
fields.description: A key stops working on its end date: when a payment extends the subscription, the school gets a key for the new date.

fields.label: Invoice schools before their trial ends
fields.description: Raises the first invoice so the school can pay before its trial runs out.

fields.label: Remind the school 3 days before its trial ends
Billing Name
fields.description: The legal name on invoices. Also used for eTIMS.

fields.label: KRA PIN
fields.description: Stemic's KRA PIN, e.g. P051234567X. Also used for eTIMS (Stemic Tax Settings follows it).

fields.label: Months per Invoice
fields.description: The period a new subscription invoice covers unless you choose otherwise.

fields.label: Send Renewal Invoices This Many Days Before the End
fields.description: 0 turns automatic renewal invoices off.

fields.label: Payment Instructions
fields.description: Shown on every invoice, reminder and welcome email, and in invoice SMS. Write {invoice} where the invoice number goes, e.g. Pay via M-Pesa Paybill 123456, Account {invoice}.

fields.label: Email schools
fields.description: From the default outgoing Email Account, to each school's contact email.

fields.label: SMS schools
fields.description: Also by SMS to each school's contact phone, through the gateway below. Links and license keys go by email only.

fields.label: What Schools Are Told
fields.description: Each switch covers both email and SMS. Platform admins get a summary of the same events (below).

fields.label: Tell platform admins about every event
fields.description: A short summary of each event above in every platform admin's notification bell and email.

fields.label: Also by SMS to platform admins
fields.description: To each admin's mobile number (User > Mobile No), when SMS schools is on. Problem alerts (a failed build, a failed operation, invoices that disagree with payments) go by SMS too.

fields.label: Branding
fields.description: How Stemic appears in every email and SMS to schools, and on a suspended school's page.

fields.label: Support Email
fields.description: Where schools are told to write. Blank: the default outgoing email address.

fields.label: Main Colour
fields.description: The email header band and links.

fields.label: Accent Colour
fields.description: Buttons and highlights.

fields.label: SMS Gateway
fields.description: Any HTTP SMS provider, from its API documentation (Africa's Talking: POST, Form, username in Other Parameters, apiKey as a header, success field SMSMessageData.Recipients.0.statusCode = 100,101,102).

fields.label: Other Parameters
fields.description: One per line: name=value. Start a line with header: for an HTTP header, e.g. header:Accept=application/json

fields.label: How to Tell an SMS Was Accepted
Success Field
fields.description: Dotted path in the JSON reply, e.g. responses.0.response-code

fields.label: Success Values
fields.description: Comma-separated, e.g. 200

fields.label: Test Phone Number
fields.description: Save, then Send Test SMS.

fields.label: Post to accounts
fields.description: No longer used: posting is compulsory once a company is chosen.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The ERPNext company that keeps Stemic's books. Once chosen, every invoice, payment, commission, payout, expense and refund is posted to it; nothing is saved without its entry.

fields.label: Platform Domain
fields.description: The default when the list below is empty. Schools' addresses are <school>.<this domain>, e.g. stemicschools.com.

fields.label: Platform Domains
fields.description: Stemic's own domains for school addresses. One is the Default; each needs a wildcard DNS record and a certificate on the server (server/README.md). Use Check Domains to see which are ready.

fields.label: DNS Lookup Service
fields.description: Used to check custom-domain ownership (DNS-over-HTTPS JSON). Default: Cloudflare.

fields.label: Create school sites on this server
fields.description: Turns queued sites into real ones on this bench. Builds them as the limited database account (stemic_provisioner) whose password is in the server's secrets file, /etc/stemic/secrets.env (README: Secrets).

fields.label: School Site Domain
fields.description: New school sites are named <school>.<this domain>, e.g. stemicschools.com. localhost on a development bench.

fields.label: Apps on Each School Site
fields.description: One per line, in install order.

fields.label: Bench Path
fields.description: Leave blank to use this bench.

fields.label: Agents Earn Commission On
fields.description: Each agent's rate is on their agent record.

fields.label: Include uploaded files
fields.description: Attachments, photos and documents. Off: database only (smaller, faster).

fields.label: Keep daily
fields.description: On this server: the newest backup of each of this many days

fields.label: Where backups are kept
fields.description: Copies on another provider survive the loss of this server. S3-compatible covers Backblaze B2, Wasabi, AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, Cloudflare R2 and MinIO.

fields.label: Destination
fields.options:
This server only
This server + S3-compatible storage

fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: e.g. https://s3.eu-central-003.backblazeb2.com, https://s3.wasabisys.com, https://fra1.digitaloceanspaces.com. Blank for AWS.

fields.label: Keep off-server copies (days)
fields.description: 0 keeps them forever. Pinned backups are always kept.

fields.label: Update every school after a code change
fields.description: When the School ERP code on this server changes, every live school is migrated, one at a time.

fields.label: Watch every school's site
fields.description: Every 15 minutes: alert when a school's site stops answering, and when it is back.

fields.label: Alert when free disk is under (%)
Alert when a certificate expires within (days)
